title: Filter High-Traffic Stadium Rows
learning_objective: Learn to isolate rows that meet a traffic threshold before checking consecutiveness.

tutorial.explanation: Consecutive-row problems often start by removing rows that do not qualify. For stadium traffic, only rows with people >= 100 matter.
tutorial.syntax: SELECT id, visit_date, people FROM stadium WHERE people >= 100;
tutorial.mental_model: Filter first, then solve the pattern problem on the smaller set.

guided_example.prompt: Show only days with at least 100 people.
guided_example.solution_query: SELECT id, visit_date, people FROM stadium WHERE people >= 100;
guided_example.explanation: The WHERE clause keeps only high-traffic rows.

practice.prompt: Return id and people for rows where people is at least 120.
practice.expected_query: SELECT id, people FROM stadium WHERE people >= 120;
